rawContent:
Thinking a lot about #BlackLivesMatter and #StopAsianHate, and how so often the burden is on communities of color to speak about our racial pain without naming the source of so much of it. 

Let's be clear. Let's be specific. 

White racist violence in America needs to stop.

When people ask me about what it will take to end white racism, I tell them to ask that of white people. 

#BlackLivesMatter + #StopAsianhate both demanding the end of white racist violence. 

Sadly, America doesn't want to give up its one of its favorite historical pastimes.
